description: A contemporary Central European or Eastern European residential exterior under a clear bright blue daytime sky. The perimeter fence is a dramatic composition of dark charcoal natural stone or dark slate cladding — three tall, chunky rectangular gate pillars with rough-cut stone facing anchor the composition at left, center-gate, and right. Between the pillars, horizontal dark metal fence panels run in parallel bands with slight gaps, creating a modern horizontal-slat effect in a very dark near-black tone. The driveway or approach surface is composed of large-format gray stone or paver tiles. At the base of the fence, a decorative gravel planting bed runs the width — large white rounded pebbles ground the fence line, from which three neatly trimmed boxwood or similar round shrubs emerge symmetrically between the pillars. The house behind the fence is a two-story suburban residence with a pale beige or cream smooth stucco exterior and a dark gray hip roof — a skylight or two is visible in the roof plane. Dark evergreen trees are visible at the property edges. Each gate pillar has a flat-topped stone cap from which a warm ambient glow can be inferred but is not prominent in the bright daylight — decorative cap fixtures are mounted atop each pillar in a lantern-with-scroll-detail form. The scene is photographed from street level, standing eye-level, wide lens, centered on the gate opening with the house in the distance. Camera is at standing eye-level, normal lens, one-point perspective looking through the gate axis toward the house. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
